done_when: The review instructions tell the reviewer, when it finds a defect, to check every sibling case of the same kind (other states, other providers, other callers of the same code) and report them together in one finding naming each place. A command-level test shows the instruction reaches the review prompt.
why: Reviews find one more case of the same defect each round (one terminal state, then another, then another), costing a round each
